# Noumi - AI Personal Assistant (Full Documentation)

> Autonomous AI Personal Assistant: Built to Actually Do the Work.

## About

Noumi is an AI personal assistant that works like a colleague — understanding context, managing tasks, and delivering results without constant prompting.

**Website:** https://noumi.ai
**Product Type:** AI Personal Assistant
**Target Users:** Product Managers, Solutions Engineers, Journalists, Content Creators, Knowledge Workers

## Core Features

### Persistent Memory
Noumi remembers your work context, preferences, and project history across sessions. It builds a continuous understanding of your goals and working style. Unlike traditional AI assistants that reset between conversations, Noumi maintains complete context across all your projects through a structured workspace system.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/features/persistent-memory

**Key Capabilities:**
- Remembers full project context across weeks and months
- Maintains conversation history and decision records
- Understands relationships between different projects
- Automatically surfaces relevant past work when needed

### Autonomous Execution
Noumi takes initiative to complete tasks end-to-end without constant prompting. It breaks down complex requests, executes steps, and delivers finished results. The AI works independently with minimal supervision, completing multi-step workflows without requiring detailed instructions for each action.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/features/autonomous-execution

**Key Capabilities:**
- Completes multi-step tasks independently
- Breaks down complex requests into actionable steps
- Delivers production-ready outputs, not just suggestions
- Works with minimal supervision once given clear goals

### Self-Evolving Skills
Noumi learns from your corrections and feedback, continuously improving its performance on your specific workflows and tasks. The system recognizes patterns in how you work and automatically applies those patterns to future tasks without being reminded.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/features/self-evolving-skills

**Key Capabilities:**
- Learns from user corrections and feedback
- Recognizes workflow patterns over time
- Builds custom capabilities for recurring tasks
- Improves performance the longer you use it

## Use Cases

### Product Manager
Noumi helps product managers with PRD writing, feature planning, user research synthesis, roadmap documentation, and stakeholder communication. The AI maintains context across product cycles and remembers past decisions.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/use-cases/product-manager

**Common Tasks:**
- Writing and updating PRDs
- Synthesizing user research findings
- Planning feature roadmaps
- Drafting stakeholder updates
- Managing product documentation

### Solutions Engineer
Noumi assists solutions engineers with technical documentation, demo preparation, customer onboarding, proof-of-concept development, and integration guides. The AI remembers customer-specific requirements and technical constraints.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/use-cases/solutions-engineer

**Common Tasks:**
- Creating technical documentation
- Preparing customer demos
- Writing integration guides
- Building proof-of-concept materials
- Documenting customer requirements

### Journalist
Noumi supports journalists with interview transcription, article drafting, fact-checking, source management, and editorial workflow automation. The AI maintains context across ongoing stories and remembers source relationships.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/use-cases/journalist

**Common Tasks:**
- Transcribing and summarizing interviews
- Drafting article outlines and first drafts
- Fact-checking and source verification
- Managing source contacts and notes
- Organizing research materials

## Key Differentiators

Unlike traditional AI assistants that require detailed prompting for every task, Noumi:
- **Works autonomously** with minimal supervision
- **Maintains long-term memory** of your projects and preferences across weeks and months
- **Learns and adapts** to your specific workflows over time
- **Delivers complete outputs** rather than suggestions or drafts
- **Understands context** without requiring constant re-explanation
